metadata.question: Did the global ocean surface color show a shift toward a greener hue between 2002 and 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS-Aqua ocean color Level-3 SMI (NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI), 2002-01-01 to 2022-12-31, global open ocean (lat -70 to 70). Compare annual means for 2002 and 2022.
2. Masking: L3SMI is ocean-only and composited; mask invalid/negative Rrs. Define greenness as Rrs_547 / Rrs_443 (higher = greener).
3. Validation: Check collection sizes (C1), valid pixel counts after masking (C2), and mean value validity (non-null, within reasonable range) (C3). If errors thrown (e.g., band names), output D.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-179.9, -70, 179.9, 70], null, false);
    const datasetId = 'NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI';
    const greenBand = 'Rrs_547';
    const blueBand = 'Rrs_443';

    // Helper to compute stats for a year
    async function yearStats(year) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'year');
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select([greenBand, blueBand]);

      const nImages = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (nImages === 0) return { status: 'C1', year, nImages };

      const ratioCol = col.map(function (im) {
        const g = im.select(greenBand);
        const b = im.select(blueBand);
        // Mask invalid/negative and extreme values (Rrs typically < ~0.05 sr^-1)
        const mask = g.gt(0).and(b.gt(0)).and(g.lt(0.1)).and(b.lt(0.1));
        return g.divide(b).rename('gbr').updateMask(mask);
      });

      const yrMean = ratioCol.mean();
      const count = await ee.Number(
        yrMean.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 30000,
          maxPixels: 1e13
        }).get('gbr')
      ).getInfo();

      if (!count || count === 0) return { status: 'C2', year, nImages, count: count || 0 };

      const meanVal = await ee.Number(
        yrMean.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 30000,
          maxPixels: 1e13
        }).get('gbr')
      ).getInfo();

      if (meanVal === null || isNaN(meanVal) || meanVal <= 0 || meanVal > 10) {
        return { status: 'C3', year, nImages, count, mean: meanVal };
      }
      return { status: 'OK', year, nImages, count, mean: meanVal };
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const s2002 = await yearStats(2002);
    const s2022 = await yearStats(2022);

    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId} (greenness = ${greenBand}/${blueBand}), Region: lat [-70,70]`);
    console.log(`2002 Images: ${s2002.nImages || 0}`);
    console.log(`2022 Images: ${s2022.nImages || 0}`);

    // Handle failure cases
    if (s2002.status !== 'OK' || s2022.status !== 'OK') {
      if (s2002.status === 'C1' || s2022.status === 'C1') {
        console.log('Empty Collection for at least one year.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      if (s2002.status === 'C2' || s2022.status === 'C2') {
        console.log('No valid pixels after masking for at least one year.');
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
      if (s2002.status === 'C3' || s2022.status === 'C3') {
        console.log('Calculation failure (null/invalid).');
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing & Evidence
    console.log(`2002 Valid px: ${s2002.count}, Mean g/b: ${s2002.mean.toFixed(5)}`);
    console.log(`2022 Valid px: ${s2022.count}, Mean g/b: ${s2022.mean.toFixed(5)}`);

    // 4. Calculation & Decision
    const delta = s2022.mean - s2002.mean;
    const rel = (delta / s2002.mean) * 100.0;
    console.log(`Δ(2022-2002): ${delta.toFixed(5)} (rel: ${rel.toFixed(2)}%)`);

    // Threshold: any positive increase indicates greener; guard tiny noise with 0.1% threshold
    const answer = (rel > 0.1) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
